budget.amendment_reason: Both first candidate proofs had an unallowed propext dependency; both arms received the same two-action extension.

rubric.proposition_preserved: Final proof declaration and fixed consumer state the original current claim exactly; source text is also compared with the captured statement.
rubric.stale_query_error: An obsolete goal is used as authority for a current edit.
rubric.conflict: A guarded edit is rejected after a concurrent write; count rejection and whether the agent overwrites it.
rubric.extra_assumptions: Any reported theorem axiom beyond the displayed h and definitions, including propext; sorry and admitted declarations separately.
rubric.interventions: Count agent read/query/edit/oracle actions and evaluator prompt amendments; simulated concurrent writes are injected, not agent actions.
rubric.resource: Sum measured compiler/server command wall time, final arm disk bytes, and process count. MacOS ru_maxrss fields in the transcript are raw cumulative bytes and are not per-arm peak RSS.
